verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a company-incorporation service, not an e-signature platform or developer API, so embedding a signing experience in a developer's own app is a category error for this product. The evidence shows SAFEs are created, sent, and tracked from the Atlas Dashboard, with nothing exposing signing to third-party apps. That dashboard feature does not make the embedding axis applicable.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the signing experience inside my own app or website
